canvas_law.description: What the world looks like when nothing is happening, and its depth/occlusion rules. The heron's law: a blank void; the water is implied by a clip plane and never drawn.

background.description: Palette name of the untouched canvas (resolves to index 0 of the scene palette).

clip_planes.description: Occlusion planes: everything on one side of the plane is hidden behind the (undrawn) medium. Heron: below the surface line = underwater = canvas color.

static_marks.description: marks the environment draws even at rest (the heron has NONE — every mark is caused; the pond-edge environment has one shore line).

effect.description: Engine effect primitive: ripple | splash | drips | puff | ring | streak.

effect_map.description: THE CAUSALITY TABLE: which clip/event types cause which procedural marks in THIS world. Lives in the environment, not the species and not the engine — a footstep ripples water but would puff dust on land. Values are lists of effect invocations with parameters; effect primitives themselves are engine code.

effect_region.description: Optional band (design coords) where surface effects are drawn; default: around the first clip plane.

zones.description: Named blocking positions in DESIGN coordinates. Mirror partners are data here (replaces v1's hard-coded L<->R swap).
